# lcd.isSwiping

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Check if the window is swiping or not.

```lua
local swiping = lcd.isSwiping()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

swiping (boolean)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
lcd.isSwiping()
```
